facts.fact: Irène 69岁独居75 rue de la Tour小公寓，用亡夫意大利姓Sampieri；Lorraine回忆"从不出门以免被围捕带走；叫Sampieri没人怀疑她是犹太人"；密封金属百叶窗、沉默如墓穴。
facts.anchor: She spent most of the years from 1941 to 1944 hidden in a small apartment on rue de la Tour,” Lorraine wrote.

facts.fact: 那些日子的定义不是行动而是恐惧——等待、倾听、脚步声在门外停下；年长女性最怕敲门声，因为跑不了、爬不了窗、消失在人群中。
facts.anchor: What defined those days wasn’t action but dread—the waiting, the listening, when footsteps paused outside.

facts.fact: 家族捐出的Champs城堡免于查抄，对公众开放、国防军守卫——但犹太人禁止入内；Cahen d'Anvers家族被禁止踏入自家捐出的城堡。
facts.anchor: But even so, the family’s gift of the castle to the state spared it from seizure and looting. It was open to the public, guarded by Wehrmacht soldiers. Entry, though, was barred to Jews.

facts.fact: Georges Prade（"Yo Yo"，政治掮客）1941年9月致信Vallat，为Irène争取Béatrice每年40,000法郎的转账豁免；付款被标为"偿还旧债"——"纸面魔法"；Vallat发了>11,000张"非犹太种族证明"。
facts.anchor: In about a week, Vallat and the financial section of his commission found a loophole and approved a transfer. The payment was labeled as a repayment of an old debt. Paper magic.

facts.fact: Irène的雅利安证明（1941-07-27）："不应被视为犹太人"；这是虚构，所有人都知道；四位祖父母全是犹太人；母亲Louise从未改宗；警方报告谎称Louise及其父母是天主教徒。
facts.anchor: The certificate said it plainly: “Ne doit pas être regardé comme juif”—“Must not be considered a Jew.” It was a fiction, and everyone knew it. All four of her grandparents were Jewish.

facts.fact: 1941年10月3日凌晨七座犹太会堂被炸（法国特工执行、盖世太保提供炸药）；rue de la Victoire会堂是Irène当年穿Worth婚纱结婚的地方，也是Nissim追思会的地方；Irène公寓距rue Copernic会堂不到一英里。
facts.anchor: One of the main targets was the synagogue on rue de la Victoire, the place where Irène had once stood in a House of Worth wedding gown, trailing silk orange blossoms.

facts.fact: Charles被Barrié骗了300万法郎买假"荣誉雅利安"证明后逃往自由区，买Château de Lias d'Armagnac；变成抵抗运动电台哨站（英国B2发报机）；Gilbert："父亲买农庄是为了帮助盟军，收留英国飞行员，用电台直到1944年底，从未停止。"
facts.anchor: My father bought the farm to help the Allies. He housed British pilots, used the radio until the end of 1944. He never stopped.”
